title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures — Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)

clauses.title: Seismic Zone Map of India & Zone Factors (Z)
clauses.text: Clause 6.4.2 & Table 3 (Seismic Zone Factors of India): Seismic zones in India are designated Zone II, Zone III, Zone IV, and Zone V (Zone I is merged with Zone II). Zone Factor (Z) represents Maximum Considered Earthquake (MCE): Zone II (Low) = 0.10; Zone III (Moderate) = 0.16; Zone IV (Severe) = 0.24; Zone V (Very Severe e.g. Himalayas, Northeast, Kutch, Bihar border) = 0.36. Design Basis Earthquake (DBE) is taken as half of MCE (Z/2).

clauses.title: Design Base Shear (Vb) Calculation Formula
clauses.text: Clause 6.4.3 (Design Base Shear Formula): Total design lateral base shear along any principal direction: Vb = Ah * W, where W is seismic weight of building, and Ah is horizontal seismic design coefficient given by Ah = (Z / 2) * (I / R) * (Sa / g). Here I is Importance factor (1.5 for critical facilities, 1.2 for schools/hospitals, 1.0 for residential), R is Response Reduction Factor (5.0 for Special RC Moment Resisting Frame / SMRF, 3.0 for Ordinary RC Frame / OMRF).
